lean_verified: collector certificate checker, its 17 certificates and the collector loop model only
model_proficiency_measured: pilot only: nine function-level tasks, one model family, rule cards and diagnostics as the only documentation, no comparison arm (evidence/v1_1/ai_pilot)

implemented.native_cpu: Linux x86-64 and AArch64, C++20 lowering, libraries and executables, clang++ and g++
implemented.scalars: fixed integers (8..64 bit), bool, strict floating point, byte text and character literals
implemented.types: generic records and sums with any value payload, tag-only enums, inline arrays, layout attributes
implemented.generics: type and natural parameters, inference, on-demand monomorphization, bounded families
implemented.traits: static dispatch on Self, multi-trait bounds checked per instance, methods by receiver module, impls held to their trait's declaration, one implementation per type (overlap and ambiguity are errors), borrowed dyn references and owned Dyn[Trait] values served by concrete and generic impls alike
implemented.memory: second-class borrows of values and arrays, checked parts, scoped and first-class zeroed owners
implemented.ownership: affine moves, take/swap, linear structs, defer, implicit release visible as effects
implemented.errors: typed sums with exhaustive match and explicit try propagation
implemented.functions: code pointers and non-escaping closures as borrowed callables; a closure borrows exactly what it captures for the call it is written in
implemented.effects: interprocedural rows with renamed footprints, pure/effects ceilings, mandatory extern effects, unsafe gate
implemented.concurrency: scoped tasks with linear tickets and borrow leases (K-way visibly disjoint parts), atomics with explicit orders, closure-entered mutexes that trap on re-entry
implemented.parallel: race-free lane regions on host threads and CUDA lanes from one body, kernel functions, reductions, device collector; lanes may call fn parameters, judged where the closure is written (lane:f footprint)
implemented.placement: host, pinned, unified and device views in the type; transfer is the only crossing; queued device regions and transfers as linear stream tickets ordered with `after`
implemented.modules: namespaces, pub, imports with aliases and name lists, a packaged std written in CAIRN
implemented.targets: hosted, CUDA through nvcc, and a freestanding AArch64 profile with MMIO and inline target instructions
implemented.generation: library-defined typed recipes over record schemas and naturals (static each/where/require/fold, $ splices, generated records and functions, domains, budgets, content hashes); the packaged std.wire recipe; static families; the certified bounded collector
implemented.projects: ordered files, data-only manifests, fresh build directories; opt-in per-module objects reused by content hash
implemented.editing: host-bound body/expression choices over the whole language, lexical rule cards, effect ceilings
implemented.tooling: comment-preserving formatter, language server, editor grammar
implemented.arithmetic_certificates: 17 exact affine implications, checked before every emission and proved in Lean
implemented.scalar_equivalence: trusted translator and Z3, explicit per-function/module coverage

not_implemented: completion-based (non-thread) asynchronous I/O, cancellation and device-loss recovery
checking a generic once against its bounds rather than per instance
SMT coverage of memory, loops, sums and floats
an equal-budget, multi-language, multi-model AI proficiency experiment with tokenizer accounting
